reviews.comment: I actually really liked this professor. This class is tough, but her lectures are good and easy to understand. Out of the other physics professors here, i would absolutely take her again. Go to class, review and STUDY, go over past exams. This course in general is hard, but she is a good professor. People rating bad probably didn't show up.

Pearson sucks and they're due at really weird inconvenient times. Reads directly off the slide with few examples. Refuses to publish grades until the day grades are due at the end of the semester... where she still doesn't publish them. It's physics, it's hard. Take anyone else, seriously.

I didn't mind taking Dr. Beckers class however I didn't show up to any lectures after the first few weeks. She reads directly off the slides and is difficult to understand. I ended up teaching myself the material through Pearson. Exams aren't terrible if you study and do the practice tests you should be fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This prof is awful at teaching but luckily the class is extremely easy if you took physics in highschool. I have not gone to lecture since the first few weeks of class and have just done the previous year exams that are provided which are EXACTLY like the actual exams.

if you have the choice dont take her. absolutely no grades in canva when emailed about it she said she wasnt putting in anything till after the final, which isn't bad but for the way the classes work its pure stupid. she doesnt give you a straight answer for anything AND DOESNT TEACH. she will read the slide say thats how you solve it and move on.

She is so kind and will always happily answer your questions. However, I never attended lecture anymore as her slides are impossible and she doesn't even write the test anyways. She gives you access to Ford's old exams (I had 5 tests to study) and they are almost exactly the same as the next test you take. Be ready to study and learn on your own.

I really liked Dr. Becker. She teaches well and is great about answering questions (so ask them). She's very down to earth. Yes, there's a lot of homework, but that homework is what really taught me the material. Just take the time and effort to learn, and she makes the rest easy. Exams are so much easier than homework.

She's a good person, but I never wore a seatbelt while driving to school because I wanted to die before making it to her lecture. She just flashes her work on the screen, so you are 100% on your own when it comes to learning. Genuinely, the worst decision I have ever made was taking Physics at A&M with Becker. Take this class somewhere else.
I was so lost. She just flashes her work on the screen. Go to the SI because he's great. Be aware of changing due dates for mastering.

There is A LOT of homework. Dont wait until the day its due to do it. She doesnt work out problems during class but instead has all the work already written down, which will not help you understand. I would leave class very confused but the SI is REALLY good and will clear up everything and will share shortcuts. Only got a B because of the SI :)
Very hard to understand, she goes too fast in lectures. I honestly wouldn't have passed the class if I didn't go to SI.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She's a very nice and intelligent woman. However, there isn't really a point in showing up to class. I taught myself the material from the online homework (which there is a lot of) She is honestly not that bad though. Study hard using the homework you are assigned and attend recitation to get an A. She is also very generous with her test curves.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Becker is obviously very intelligent and well-versed in the subject matter- unfortunately because of that it seems to be that she doesn't know how to teach an intro class and make it understandable. Exams are hard, and there are 4 midterms plus a final. Class is not mandatory and tutoring and recitation will be your best friends.

reviews.ratingTags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: If you go to A+ tutoring and are decent at math, youll for sure get a B. The tests are curved pretty heavy. Honestly easier than I expected. Shes hard to understand and never sure what to say. If no A+, youll be teaching yourself everything.
